title: Nudged Elastic Band
description: config.ini [Nudged Elastic Band] section (NudgedElasticBandConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

images.description: Number of NEB images between the fixed endpoints.

spring.description: The spring constant, in eV/Ang^2 between the images.

solid_state.description:
Relax the lattice vectors of each interior image with the atoms.

The cell of each interior image moves with the atoms. The cell stays
lower triangular: the first lattice vector lies on x and the second lies
in the xy plane, so the band cannot rotate as a rigid body. Atomic
displacements and cell strain share one Jacobian
(doi:10.1063/1.3684549). Periodic boundaries are required. A potential
that does not report the Cauchy stress is refused.
``ci_mmf``, ``zoom_neb``, ``onsager_machlup``, ``neb_doubly_nudged``,
and ``neb_elastic_band`` are refused, and ``initializer`` must be
``linear`` or ``file``.

solid_state_weight.description: Multiplier on the cell block of the solid-state Jacobian (doi:10.1063/1.3684549). 1 weights a cell strain like an atomic move.

temperature.description: Temperature in kelvin for the harmonic quantum free energy along the band. Zero leaves the profile on the potential energy.

tunnel_wall_points.description: Force calls past each end minimum of the converged band, along its end segment continued outward, for the outer walls of the one-dimensional tunnelling levels. 0 continues each well by its fit.

solid_state_pressure.description: External hydrostatic pressure in eV/Angstrom^3 on the solid-state band. Positive pressure favors a smaller cell. 0 keeps the potential-energy band.

climbing_image_method.description:
Indicates if the climbing image method is used.

As discussed in :cite:t:`neb-henkelmanClimbingImageNudged2000`.

old_tangent.description:
Indicates if the old tangent method is used.

From :cite:t:`neb-millsQuantumThermalEffects1994`, before :cite:t:`neb-henkelmanImprovedTangentEstimate2000`.

neb_max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations allowed for the NEB.

neb_climbing_image_converged_only.description: If true, NEB convergence compares the climbing image to the force tolerance, but only after the rest of the band is within climbing_image_band_slack times that tolerance.

neb_climbing_image_band_slack.description: When climbing_image_converged_only is true, reject convergence if any non-CI image exceeds this multiple of the force tolerance.

neb_doubly_nudged.description: Indicates if the doubly nudged method is used.

neb_doubly_nudged_switching.description:
Indicates if the doubly nudged switching method is used.

Method as demonstrated in :cite:t:`neb-trygubenkoDoublyNudgedElastic2004`.

neb_elastic_band.description: Indicates if the elastic band method is used.

converged_force.description:
Converged force threshold for the NEB.

This defaults to being the same as :any:`eon.schema.OptimizerConfig.converged_force`

onsager_machlup.description:
Indicates if the Onsager-Machlup (OM) Action is used.

Method as demonstrated in :cite:t:`neb-mandelliModifiedNudgedElastic2021`.

om_optimize_k.description: Indicates if the Onsager-Machlup (OM) Action spacing is recalculated at each step.

om_k_scale.description:
Indicates stiffness of OM adaption of springs.

Stiffness:
- > 1 (stiff) provides a smoother path but may "cut corners" near the saddle
- < 1 (softer) hugs valleys but paths may become jagged/noisy

geometric_spring.description: Parallel spring from the difference of squared neighbour distances.

band_precon.description:
Metric inside the band projection of the rgsaddle band.

``exp`` calls ``rgsaddle_band_set_exp_precon``: the per-image Exp
metric of Packwood et al. (2016) inside the band projection, as
Makri, Ortner and Kermode (2019), Eq. (9) and (10), write it
(:cite:t:`neb-makriPreconditioningScheme2019`). The spring constant
enters as the dimensionless ``kappa = spring / mu``. Needs the
rgsaddle band (``opt_method`` lbfgs, fire or xtsci on a build linked
to rgsaddle 0.3.0 or newer, C ABI minor 22). Refused with
``solid_state``, with one atom per image, and with ``energy_weighted``
or ``onsager_machlup``. Also refused when any atom is fixed: the C
API has no fixed-atom mask. The function takes ``A``, ``c_stab``,
``mu`` and ``r_cut_factor``. It has no absolute cutoff and no shift.

band_precon_A.description: Exp exponent A in exp(-A (r / r_nn - 1)). 0 selects 3.

band_precon_mu.description:
Energy scale mu of the band metric; 0 lets rgsaddle estimate it.

The estimate is one force row on a copy of the first interior image
before the first step.

band_precon_r_cut_factor.description:
Cutoff as a multiple of the nearest-neighbour distance. 0 selects 2.

Pairs inside ``r_cut_factor * r_nn`` enter the metric. A value in
(0, 1] is refused. The C API has no absolute ``r_cut``.

band_precon_c_stab.description:
Diagonal stabilization C_stab of the Exp metric. 0 selects 0.1.

The diagonal carries ``mu * C_stab``. The C API has no shift argument.

band_stepper.description:
Stepper of the rgsaddle band.

``auto`` follows ``opt_method``. ``ode12r`` selects
``RGSADDLE_METHOD_ODE12R``, the adaptive ODE12r stepper of Makri,
Ortner and Kermode (2019). With ``band_precon = exp`` that is
ODE12r-Exp. The C API does not take ODE12r tolerances: the library
fixes ``rtol`` at 0.1, ``c1`` at 0.01 and ``c2`` at 2, and there is
no ``atol`` argument. Needs rgsaddle 0.3.0 or newer.

energy_weighted.description:
Indicates if the energy-weighted method is used.

Method as demonstrated in :cite:t:`neb-asgeirssonNudgedElasticBand2021`.

ew_ksp_min.description: Minimum value for KSP in the energy-weighted method.

ew_ksp_max.description: Maximum value for KSP in the energy-weighted method.

initial_path_in.description:
File from which the initial path is read.

This file must contain a list of .con files, one per image on the path.

initializer.description:
Initialization strategy.

Options:
- ``linear``: Euclidean distance based image interpolation for initial NEB paths.
- ``idpp``: Image depedent pair potential initialzation :cite:t:`neb-smidstrupImprovedInitialGuess2014`.
- ``idpp_collective``: IDPP as a potential initialized with the NEB.
- ``sidpp``: Sequential Image depedent pair potential initialzation :cite:t:`neb-schmerwitzImprovedInitializationOptimal2024`.
- ``file``: Start from an arbitrary path, needs initial_path_in set as well.

init_max_iterations.description: Steps to run the IDPP for.

init_force_threshold.description: Force threshold for NEB IDPP initialization.

sidpp_growth_alpha.description: The step size for adding new images in S-IDPP.

minimize_endpoints.description: Minimize the reactant and product before the NEB.

minimize_endpoints_for_ipath.description: Minimize the reactant and product before the NEB, even if an initial path is provided.

ci_after.description: Convergence before the CI is turned on.

ci_mmf.description: Use an MMF method for the CI.

ci_mmf_after.description: Convergence before the CI is turned on.

ci_mmf_nsteps.description: Number of steps for which the MMF is run at the CI image.

ci_mmf_ci_stability_count.description: Number of stable iterations before settling on a CI image index.

ci_mmf_restore_unhelpful.description: Restore the walked image after an alignment reject or force increase on that image. A CI-index hop after a downhill dimer step is not a force increase. False is the Frontiers OCI-NEB protocol (doi:10.3389/fchem.2026.1807063, Algorithm 1): restore only on positive curvature.

zoom_neb.description: After the climbing image is stable, pack every image onto a window around it and continue the band, including OCINEB.

zoom_alpha.description: Auto window keeps images above this fraction of the barrier height, measured from the lower endpoint.

zoom_offset.description: Manual window half-width in images on each side of the climbing image.

zoom_mode.description: auto uses zoom_alpha; manual uses zoom_offset.

zoom_after.description: Band force that arms Zoom-NEB. 0 uses ten times converged_force.

zoom_interpolation.description: Arc-length interpolation used to pack images into the window.

zoom_ci_stability.description: Iterations the climbing-image index must stay fixed before zoom.

zoom_max_iterations.description: Iterations allowed after zoom. 0 keeps the band iteration cap.
